# Korea Search & AI Audit Toolkit

> A downloadable Windows toolkit for technical website audits covering Google, Naver, and AI-search-related signals.

## Main page
- https://dlaepdfuf89-crypto.github.io/korea-search-ai-audit/

## Product facts
- Windows desktop toolkit
- One-time purchase; no monthly subscription
- Audits public website URLs and generates prioritized HTML reports
- Does not guarantee rankings, traffic, indexing, search exposure, or AI citations
